🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No operational data processed on non-UK-sovereign infrastructure — commando operations sovereignty is non-negotiable
  • ❌ No engagement decision made without human-in-the-loop — AI recommends, commando commanders decide
  • ❌ No classified intelligence shared with allies without sovereign data filtering — UK-eyes-only compartment preserved
  • ❌ No personnel selection decision made without human override — AI supports, humans select and reject
  • ❌ No expeditionary network connected without cyber resilience verification — tactical communications security mandatory
  • ❌ No amphibious operation launched without multi-source deconfliction — zero fratricide standard for ship-to-shore movement
